about.aboutMeDesc: A bit about my background and what I do.
about.background1: I'm a full-stack developer with a passion for building well-architected software. I care deeply about developer experience, performance optimization, and writing clean, maintainable code.
about.background2: My journey in software started with curiosity about how websites work, which led me down the path from frontend to backend, from JavaScript to TypeScript, Rust, and Go. I enjoy working across the entire stack — from designing database schemas to crafting responsive user interfaces.
about.background3: When I'm not coding, you can find me reading about systems design, contributing to open-source projects, or writing about what I've learned on this blog.
